archive: phase5c6_results.json; endpoint parameter vectors copied verbatim

observations.generation_only_simulator: existing shoebox image-source model, first order, seed-11 room/source/microphone fixture

inverse_model.plane_model: six arbitrary shared planes n_k dot x + d_k = 0; unit normals, inside means n_k dot x+d_k<0
inverse_model.plane_parameterization: six azimuth/elevation unit normals; d_k=-max_x(n_k dot x)-(1e-4*L+exp(g_k)), with L the candidate point-cloud maximum coordinate span, ensuring a numerical strict-containment margin; 18 free parameters
inverse_model.convexity: bounded enclosure iff origin lies strictly inside convex hull of the six outward normals; validated post-fit via hull halfspaces and normal rank diagnostics
inverse_model.objective: sum over each (mic,source) group of squared sorted-TOA differences, residuals multiplied by c, plus a weight-10 hinge penalty on bounce intersections outside finite convex faces; final all-path face feasibility is a hard acceptance check
inverse_model.association_justification: For equal-cardinality scalar sets and squared error, the rearrangement inequality makes sorted-to-sorted assignment globally minimum over all permutations. This does not imply a fixed wall identity/order across groups.
inverse_model.optimizer: SciPy least_squares trust-region reflective, numerical finite-difference Jacobian, x_scale=jac, ftol=xtol=gtol=1e-11, max_nfev=400
inverse_model.initialization: candidate-point PCA frame plus six deterministic independently seeded generic directions formed from perturbed antipodal random vectors; PCA-derived or random positive support gaps; no true plane information; no paired-wall constraint after initialization
inverse_model.positive_paths: image-source distances and arrival times checked finite and positive after fitting

limitations: The synthetic observations are generated from a shoebox, while the inverse allows any bounded six-plane convex enclosure.
A failed local optimizer run is not evidence of infeasibility.
Finite multi-start success is not proof of global uniqueness.
No wall reflectivity/amplitude data are used; this is echo-TOA-only.
The endpoint coordinates/timing are fixed separately; this test asks whether each can explain the echoes with some shared room.
